description: Create a 'Follow-up Configuration Dialog' that appears when a lead is moved to the followups stage (via pipeline drag or lead detail stage dropdown). The dialog lets the salesperson configure: 1) Email snippet selection, 2) Start date & time for email reminders, 3) Frequency (daily/alternate days/weekly), 4) Max days (stop after X days). After the user confirms, the existing handleStageChange() is called with these custom parameters instead of using defaults.
steps: 1. Create a new component file src/components/followup-config-dialog.tsx with a Dialog that contains: (a) A Select dropdown to pick an email snippet from the email_snippets table (fetched via supabase query), with a 'Default template' option, (b) A datetime-local input for when reminders should start (default: 1 hour from now), (c) A Select for frequency: Daily (1), Alternate days (2), Weekly (7), (d) A number input for 'Stop after X days' (default: 7), (e) Confirm and Cancel buttons. The dialog receives props: open, onOpenChange, leadId, clientName, clientEmail, userId, onConfirm callback. Use the same UI patterns as the existing 'reason required' dialog in pipeline.tsx (Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter).

2. Modify src/lib/stage-reminders.ts: Update triggerStageReminder() to accept optional override parameters: snippetId, intervalDays, stopDays, sendAt. When these are provided, use them instead of the defaults from TEMPLATES or admin config. Also update handleStageChange() to accept an optional 'emailConfig' parameter with these fields, and pass them through to triggerStageReminder().

3. Modify src/routes/_authenticated/pipeline.tsx: When a lead is dragged to the 'followups' stage, instead of immediately calling handleStageChange(), open the FollowupConfigDialog. On confirm, call handleStageChange() with the user's chosen email config. The DB stage update (move.mutate) should still happen immediately for responsiveness, but the email reminder creation waits for dialog confirmation. If the user cancels the dialog, still move the lead (follow-up task is created) but skip the custom email config (use defaults or skip email reminders).

4. Modify src/routes/_authenticated/leads/$id.tsx: When the stage dropdown is changed to 'followups', show the same FollowupConfigDialog before calling handleStageChange(). Apply the same pattern: stage update happens, then dialog appears for email config. On lead detail page, also enhance the FollowUpComposer section to show a separate 'Configure Email Reminders' button that opens the dialog for leads already in followups stage, allowing the salesperson to customize reminder settings for existing followup leads.
acceptance_criteria: When a lead is dragged to followups in pipeline, a configuration dialog appears with snippet selection, start time, frequency, and max days options
When lead stage is changed to followups via the lead detail dropdown, the same dialog appears
The dialog fetches and displays available email snippets from the email_snippets table
Frequency options include Daily, Alternate days, and Weekly
User can set a custom start date/time and stop-after-days value
On confirm, the reminder is created with the user's chosen settings (not defaults)
On cancel, the lead still moves to followups stage and auto follow-up task is created, but email reminders use defaults
The build passes: bun run build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
verification: Run 'bun run build' and confirm it completes successfully with no errors
findings: Redesigned dialog with modern UI: DateTimePicker replaces native datetime-local, segmented pill toggles replace frequency dropdown, Slider replaces stop-days number input. Added icons, gradient header, badges, and estimated email count. Client build passes (SSR build fails with pre-existing cloudflare:workers resolution issue unrelated to these changes). Props interface unchanged - backward compatible.
